newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's bourse ends session 0.29 percent lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's bourse ends session 0.29 percent lower.

text.p: The Tunis stock exchange on Thursday closed down by 0.29 percent despite higher trade boosted by the over-the-counter exchanges, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 451.12 points, down from 452.41 on Wednesday.
Insurance firm ASTREE fell 2.06 dinars to 22.8 dinars.
Amen Bank was down 0.78 dinar to 31 dinars.
Investment fund Placement de Tunisie eased 0.22 dinar to 11.16.
Cola and beer bottler Societe Frigorifique et Brasserie de Tunis was up 0.42 dinar to 79 dinars.
Societe Tunisienne de Banque rose 0.3 dinar to 12.38 dinars.
Most of the trade was in airline Tunis Air with 13,103 shares changing hands at 23 dinars each.
Total volume was 1.87 million dinars against 615,172 dinars over the previous session. Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 1.15 million dinars.
